Laura — quick thoughts from infra/ops after scanning the quote (internal only):

- Seat count: confirm 420 seats (Dev/Prod SRE + Eng rotations). We should negotiate to price at actual seats + cap at 500 instead of buying full 500 at list. Ask for matrix showing 350/420/500 for transparency.
- Multi-zone failover SOW: must include explicit failover test windows, runbook steps for traffic failover, and a rollback checklist. Request that PagerLess commit to a test window and add it to SLA credits if the feature isn't available by agreed date.
- Analytics addon: prefer flat-rate model for company-wide metrics rather than per-seat; that reduces future license churn and makes cost forecasting easier.
- Security/compliance: ask for SOC2 Type II, encryption-at-rest details, and data residency statement (we have EU customers).

Also +1 on asking for 12 vs 24 month price comparisons. Monica — once you have their SOC2 we can start procurement intake; I can sign off on technical SOW if the runbook and failover SLAs look good.
